prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Choose a pet friend below to see how they behave on your desktop screen.", "Select your companion style"]
1: ["Try Your Desktop Controls", "Click your pet to interact, drag to reposition, or use hotkeys to hide anytime.", "Got It, Let's Go!", "Quick Controls Test"]
2: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your pet's traits and sync progress across devices.", "Complete Sign In"]
3: ["How Would You Like to Adopt?", "Pick a ready-to-go companion or build a unique custom pet from your photos.", "You can always customize or add more pets later.", "Adoption Paths"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Deployment", "We are compiling pet graphics and configuring desktop window integration.", "Engine Initialization"]
5: ["Already have a pet? Sign in with your existing account and your pet will be automatically restored.", "Auto-Restores Existing Pets"]
6: ["Verifying Custom Pet Render", "Checking image sharpness and background separation to ensure a clean desktop look.", "Looks Great, Continue"]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready to Explore Your Desktop!", "Your companion is now active on your screen. You can move them anywhere or tweak settings in the tray.", "Start Playing Now"]
8: ["Pick Your Companion Path in 2 Quick Steps", "Choose a instant starter pet or create a custom companion. You can add more pets anytime later!", "Takes less than 2 minutes. No credit card required."]
9: ["We'll notify you desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready!", "Desktop Alert Enabled"]
